translations.answer: The original author validated only changing the base position in q1/q2 to obtain the same centroidal momentum, and the maintainer later confirmed that the q partial derivative missed an item. This change has been merged into PR #1474 in the CoM translated dh_dq and dhdot_dq momentum blocks, and the finite difference test has been updated to directly compare hg/dhg. It is recommended to confirm that the target Pinocchio includes the merged submission d780648 or an equivalent patch; the thread did not provide a formal release for the first fix, and the original author's merged matrix is not the same as the new matrix after the maintainer's changes.
translations.applicability: This applies to the old computeCentroidalDynamicsDerivatives in FreeFlyer position derivatives; the target installation should verify if PR #1474 is included.
translations.credibility.rationale: The issue has been closed, the environment is clear and there is no conflict, and there is formal documentation or precise reference to the exact situation.
translations.details.attempts.0: The original author used CppAD for comparison and used q1/q2 to only change the FreeFlyer position directly in the function value check.
translations.details.attempts.1: The maintainer submitted PR #1474, modified the two centroidal derivatives paths and the finite difference unit test.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Constructed a pair configuration that only changes the FreeFlyer position, first verifying the centroidal momentum itself is unchanged.
translations.details.diagnostics.1: Parsed dh_dq and compared with automatic differentiation/finite difference, and separately checked the three columns of base translation.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Use the Pinocchio with the merged submission d780648 from PR #1474, or verify if the target version includes the equivalent centroidal derivatives patch fix.
translations.details.environments.0: 2021 Pinocchio computeCentroidalDynamicsDerivatives and CppAD comparison; the original post did not provide version, OS, or model file, and the fix is fixed in PR #1474/commit d780648.
translations.details.limits.0: The original author did not publish a new CppAD numerical matrix after PR #1474 merged; the closure is based on the original author's function value comparison, the maintainer's confirmation, the patch, and the test.
translations.details.limits.1: The thread did not declare a formal release for the first fix; you cannot guess the version based on the number alone.
translations.details.limits.2: This card only covers the missing centroidal derivative for FreeFlyer translation, and does not extrapolate all centroidal derivative differences.
translations.details.outcomes.0: PR #1474 has been merged; the patch updates both the dh_dq/dhdot_dq calculation and the centroidal derivatives finite difference test.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Why is the old dh_dq still non-zero when only the FreeFlyer world translation is changed, and where is the fix?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Before parsing derivatives into contact or momentum optimization, continue to retain automatic differentiation or finite difference regression to avoid reintroducing gradient errors from old binaries or different joint models.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The maintainer finally confirmed that the q partial derivative missed an item; PR #1474 adds the corresponding angular momentum derivative terms related to linear momentum and CoM derivative after translating the force set to CoM.
translations.details.symptoms.0: The parsed dh_dq for FreeFlyer position is non-zero, but CppAD returns zero.
translations.details.symptoms.1: The original author used Pinocchio to separately calculate q1/q2 for only different base translation, and got h1 and h2 to be the same.
translations.source.locator: Pinocchio #1473 comment 886642671 provides h1/h2 comparison; comment 886658456 confirms the missing item; PR #1474 has been merged and updated the implementation and test.
